test_cases.rationale: Happy path login with valid credentials should return 200 and a token.
Missing required username field should trigger a validation error.
Missing required password field should trigger a validation error.
Empty payload with no username or password should fail validation.
Empty string credentials should be rejected as invalid input.
Numeric values for username and password instead of strings should fail validation.
Invalid credentials should return an unauthorized or bad request response.
Health endpoint should return 200 with no authentication required.
Authenticated GET on tasks should return a 200 with an array of tasks.
GET tasks without authorization header should be rejected as unauthorized.
GET tasks with an invalid token should return an unauthorized error.
Authenticated POST with valid task data should create and return the task.
Creating a task with only the title field should succeed if description and completed are optional.
Creating a task with an empty payload should fail validation if title is required.
Creating a task without authorization should be rejected.
Creating a task with an invalid token should return unauthorized.
Creating a task with an empty title string should fail validation.
Providing a numeric value for the title field should fail validation.

payload.title: A very long title that exceeds normal expectations and is used to test boundary conditions for the title field length in the task creation endpoint

test_cases.rationale: A very long title is an edge case to verify if there are length constraints enforced.
Authenticated GET for a valid task ID should return the task details.
GET a specific task without authorization should be rejected.
GET a specific task with an invalid token should return unauthorized.
Requesting a task with a non-existent ID should return a 404 not found.
ID 0 is a boundary value that likely does not correspond to a valid task.
Providing a non-integer string as task_id should trigger a validation error.
Negative task ID is an invalid boundary value and should return not found or validation error.
Authenticated PUT with valid update data should return the updated task.
Updating a task without authorization should be rejected.
Updating a task with an invalid token should return unauthorized.
Updating a non-existent task should return a 404 not found.
Sending an empty payload to update a task should fail validation.
Updating a task with an empty title string should fail validation.
Non-integer task_id in path should trigger a validation error for PUT.
Providing numeric value for title in update should fail type validation.
Authenticated DELETE of a valid task ID should succeed with a 200 response.
Deleting a task without authorization should be rejected.
Deleting a task with an invalid token should return unauthorized.
Deleting a non-existent task should return a 404 not found.
Non-integer task_id in path for DELETE should trigger a validation error.
ID 0 is a boundary edge case that should not map to a valid task.
Negative task_id is an invalid boundary and should return not found or validation error.
Negative task_id for update is an invalid boundary and should not find any resource.
Providing a string instead of boolean for completed field should fail validation.
Creating a task with completed set to true should succeed as a valid happy path variant.
Sending an unexpected extra header should not break the GET tasks endpoint.
Null value for username should trigger a validation error as username is a required string field
Null value for password should trigger a validation error as password is a required string field
Sending login request with wrong Content-Type should fail since endpoint expects application/json
Extremely long username string tests boundary conditions and potential max-length validation on the username field
Authorization header without the 'Bearer' prefix is a malformed token format and should be rejected as unauthorized
Null value for required title field in task creation should trigger a validation error
Providing an integer for the description field instead of a string should fail type validation
Null value for boolean completed field should trigger a validation error if the field does not allow null
POST /tasks with incorrect Content-Type should fail since the endpoint requires application/json body
Malformed authorization header without Bearer prefix should be rejected for GET /tasks/{task_id}
Null value for title in task update payload should fail validation if title must be a non-null string
Partial update with only the completed field should succeed if TaskUpdate schema fields are all optional
Deleting the same task a second time (after it has already been deleted) should return 404 to verify non-idempotent behavior or proper error handling
Very large integer task_id that is valid as an integer type but does not exist in the system should return 404
Very large integer task_id for PUT that does not exist should return 404
Very large integer task_id for DELETE that does not exist should return 404
Malformed authorization header without Bearer prefix should be rejected for PUT /tasks/{task_id}
Malformed authorization header without Bearer prefix should be rejected for DELETE /tasks/{task_id}
Sending extra unknown fields in the request body should either be silently ignored and return 200, or rejected — this test verifies the API's handling of additional properties
When no tasks exist for the authenticated user, GET /tasks should still return 200 with an empty array rather than 404 or another error
